question: On the full six-dimensional local auxiliary perturbation IC tangent space of pinned model=2, is the translated literature RT 00 covector propagated proportionally by the implemented evolution, as required for the R00=0 hyperplane to be invariant on that tangent space?
response_definition: For each seed j, DeltaR_j(t)=R00(seed_j,t)-R00(baseline,t), using identical physical/background/matter inputs. The baseline has the historical explicit zero auxiliary perturbation ICs. Seeds are disposable tangent-basis calculations only.
invariance_theorem: Let r0_j=DeltaR_j(t0) and rt_j=DeltaR_j(t). If the initial R00=0 hyperplane is invariant under the linear implemented flow on the sampled auxiliary IC tangent space, then rt must be proportional to r0. Equivalently every pairwise minor W_ij=rt_i*r0_j-rt_j*r0_i must vanish. This condition is invariant under arbitrary independent rescalings of the six seed coordinates.

pair_activity.definition: A pair is active when its normalized-minor denominator is at least relative_denominator_floor times the largest pair denominator for that mode and epoch.

decision_rules.ill_conditioned: If any binding mode/epoch has fewer than 3 active seed pairs in either tree, classify ill-conditioned.
decision_rules.derivative_limited: Otherwise, if the absolute difference between primary and cross tree-level median normalized-minor statistics exceeds 0.10 at any binding epoch, classify derivative-limited.
decision_rules.invariant: Otherwise, if the primary tree-level median normalized minor is <=0.05 at both a=0.1 and a=0.5 in both trees, classify auxiliary hyperplane invariant within the frozen test.
decision_rules.noninvariant: Otherwise, if in each tree at least one binding epoch has primary tree-level median normalized minor >=0.25, classify auxiliary hyperplane non-invariant within the frozen test.

guards: This tests the local six-dimensional auxiliary homogeneous tangent space, not the retarded-boundary-condition theory space globally.
A non-invariant result is an implementation/first-integral diagnostic, not a completed-U1 no-go.
Unit seed choices do not enter the binding proportionality claim because normalized pairwise minors are invariant under independent seed rescaling.
No physical action, translation or likelihood coefficient is fitted.
